summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for an offering of 167.5M Series A Depositary Shares, each representing a 1/20th interest in a share of 6.25% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock at $50 per depositary share, raising ~$8.38B proceeds before expenses. The preferred stock carries a $1,000 liquidation preference per share and pays cumulative dividends at 6.25% annually, payable quarterly in cash or Class A common stock. Mandatory conversion occurs by May 2029 into a variable number of Class A common shares based on VWAP. The company intends to list the depositary shares on Nasdaq under GOOGM. Underwriters include an over-allotment option. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, capital returns, and potential buybacks. Watch for conversion mechanics and dilution, but no special-situation M&A or activist angle applies.
